// purpose: Editor/type-check-only project for e2e/ — NOT wired into `npm run typecheck:web` (packages/web/tsconfig.json only includes src, and eslint.config.js already ignores packages/web/e2e/**), since Playwright's own runtime transform (tsx-like, via esbuild) never type-checks either. Exists so an editor opening a spec file resolves @playwright/test's types and the .js-extension imports into ../src's .ts/.tsx sources without erroring.
